sources.supports: Z.AI's current pricing page lists GLM-5.2 at $1.4 input, $4.4 output, and $0.26 cached input per 1M tokens. It does not state when those rates began.

notes: The available provider page confirms the after price but does not establish whether the earlier zero price was ever official or when the listed rates took effect. An Internet Archive CDX lookup did not return within the available request window, so there is no usable snapshot pair to bracket the change.
